column3: “The flock” supplies an object after scatters.
BSB’s “runs away” matches the Textus Receptus (φεύγει); the critical text lacks the clause.
“Sheep” supplies the referent of My own.
“Us in suspense” renders our soul held up.
“Did not believe” replaces do not believe.
“Refuse” adds volitional emphasis to do not believe.
BSB’s “My Father … is greater” and the last “My” match the Textus Receptus (μου); the critical text calls what He has given greater (μεῖζόν).
